svg.data-power-max-scope: 45 C, optics fully populated, 100% traffic load
svg.data-single-phase-110v-derating: both PSUs run at 1000 W each, 2000 W total, on a single 110 VAC source
svg.data-timing: Stratum 3E OCXO, SyncE, IEEE 1588v2 (G.8265.1, G.8275.1, G.8275.2, T-GM, T-BC/OC, T-TC)
svg.data-timing-profiles-licensed: SMPTE ST 2059-2 requires an additional license
svg.data-timing-interfaces: GNSS SMA in, 1PPS SMB in/out, 10MHz SMB in/out, ToD RJ45 in/out
svg.data-gnss: internal receiver for master clock implementations
svg.data-timing-cables: 50 ohm SMA coax with 1/4-36UNS-2B for GNSS, 50 ohm SMB coax with 10-32UNF-2A for 1PPS and 10MHz, shielded RJ45 for ToD
svg.data-tsn: Time Sensitive Networking, Class C timing accuracy
svg.data-breakout: SFP28 ports 0-3 break out of QSFP28 port 0; enabling them disables port 0
svg.data-nos-required: NOS integration is necessary to activate the timing and sync features
svg.data-optics-sfp28: 25G SR/LR/ER, 10G SFP+ SR/LR/ER, up to 40 km
svg.data-emc: FCC Part 15 Subpart B Class A, ICES-003 Class A, EN 55032 Class A, EN 55024, EN 55035, EN 62479, EN 50663, EN 300 386, EN 301 489, EN 303 413, BSMI, VCCI CISPR 32 Class A
svg.data-nebs: NEBS statements only - the guide carries the Common Bonding Network, SPD, DC-I return and intra-building OOB wording, and states no Level. It is not a certification claim

g.data-description: the drawn jack is keyway-DOWN with its two lamps at the BOTTOM corners; common/rj45-port@4 drew the opposite (keyway-up) by default, which is why the pre-sweep placement carried rotate: 180. Checked in a 7x crop of fig-0015 against the TOD and console bezels beside it, which are keyway-down with no lamps and need no rotation. common/rj45-eth@1 is keyway-down by default already, matching the photo directly, so no rotate is needed now. The HIG tables no per-lamp meaning for this jack - unlike the S9510-28DC guide, which does - so the two lamps keep the component default
g.title: mgmt

g.data-description: HIG SYNC row - Off (system timing synchronization is disabled), Solid Green (system timing, 1588 and SyncE, synchronized to an external reference: GNSS, 1PPS, PTP), Blinking Green (synchronized in SyncE mode), Solid Amber (free-run or holdover). The table lists no blinking amber for this lamp
g.title: led-sync

g.data-description: HIG SYS row - Off (no power), Solid Green (system boot complete), Solid Amber (power is up but system boot has failed). Three states, no blink
g.title: led-sys

g.data-description: HIG FAN row - Off (no FAN modules present or FAN modules are not initialized), Solid Green (all FAN modules are working normal), Blinking Amber (one or more FAN modules need service)
g.title: led-fan

g.data-description: HIG PS0 row - Off (no power), Solid Green (PSU0 is working normal), Blinking Amber (PSU0 fail, PSU0 needs service)
g.title: led-ps0

g.data-description: HIG PS1 row - Off (no power), Solid Green (PSU1 is working normal), Blinking Amber (PSU1 fail, PSU1 needs service)
g.title: led-ps1

g.data-description: HIG ID row - Off (no power), Blinking Blue (enabled beacon feature). The only lamp on this panel with a single lit state, and the only blue one
g.title: led-id
